source: Offline-tuned on 2026-09-29 with tools/rdna2_028/tune_prod_shapes.py (>=10 iterations, 25 ms/solver budget, numerical check tolerances 0.01/0.01) on all four GPUs in parallel; the shape list is the union of every key in the harvested set (the 903-row snapshot) plus the missing M in {1..8} for every (N, K) projection already seen at M <= 32 (the cudagraph capture sizes for MTP-0 [1,2,4,8] and MTP-2 [3,6,12,24] that the harvested set never included). Curated against fresh same-process heuristic / current / new measurements (tools/rdna2_028/tune_prod_shapes.py --mode measure, GPU 0, 5 warmup + 15 reps median): for every shape the chosen solver is whichever condition is fastest, new is only adopted when it beats both current and heuristic by >= 2 %, and rows slower than the heuristic by more than 3 % are dropped. Default rows are folded into the dropped set so the shipped file is small and behaviourally identical to the heuristic at those shapes.
validated: 2026-09-29: lookup-only vs heuristic A/B confirms the lm_head decode win (tn_62080_M<=8: 2.7-3.0x), 4/4 production cells passed coherence on W4A16 and W4A8, no PCI SERR. Solution IDs are build-specific; identical V620 cards share one row set since per-card variation in the harvested file was noise.
storage_policy: Fork rows are the shared source of truth. Never store rows in /tmp or the run CWD. Per-user fallback: $HOME/.cache/tunableop/tunableop_results.csv. Consume via tools/rdna2_028/tunableop_env.sh (configure_tunableop).
